LESSON: READING 8.2.1 FLUENCY IN READING

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 8
Topic 8.2: Reading 8.2.1 Fluency in Reading
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 8.2.1 Fluency in Reading, part of Strand 8 in Grade 5 ENGLISH LANGUAGE.

Key inquiry question: What makes someone a good reader? 2. How long do you take to read a text? 3. What can you do to improve your reading speed?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. scan through paragraphs for unfarmiliar words collaboratively,

2. search for an article on a topic they enjoy, select a portion to read,

3. set a goal on the number of words to be read per minute,

4. find a word or phrase from a word - chart within a stipulated time,

5. read a text in unison, as a class or small group (choral reading),

6. participate in a reader’s theatre using a short text from a poem or short play, o select a story or poem that can be divided into parts or characters, o assign a portion to each member with peers, o read a portion of the script orally for practice, o read the assigned parts with peers, 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. scan through paragraphs for unfarmiliar words collaboratively,
2. search for an article on a topic they enjoy, select a portion to read,
3. set a goal on the number of words to be read per minute,
4. find a word or phrase from a word - chart within a stipulated time,
5. read a text in unison, as a class or small group (choral reading),
6. participate in a reader’s theatre using a short text from a poem or short play, o select a story or poem that can be divided into parts or characters, o assign a portion to each member with peers, o read a portion of the script orally for practice, o read the assigned parts with peers, 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading 8.2.1 Fluency in Reading together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Learning to Learn is promoted as the learner practices reading texts at the right speed and pace with the correct

expression for effective communication.

Values:
Unity is enhanced as the learner reads a text and participates in a reader’s theatre collaboratively.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Environmental Activities are reinforced as the learner interacts with information about cash crops through participating

in readers’ theatre.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner can apply the skill of reading fluency in all other areas of learning.
